description: The corpus is entirely frontend/CSS corrections (including a promoted flexbox-not-floats theme). The current task is a backend database-migration bug with no overlap. The correct answer is that NOTHING is relevant. This tests whether a retriever can abstain: neither recurrence nor recency can, so both surface confidently-irrelevant entries — an honest limitation worth measuring. An empty relevant set means recall is vacuously 1; precision is what matters here.
